name: Question 5
problem:
Find the eigenvectors of the $2\times 2$ matrix $B$ given that 

$$
[\begin{aligned}8 & 3 \\ 5 & 2\end{aligned}]B=[\begin{aligned}-2 & 0 \\ 0 & 7\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}8 & 3 \\ 5 & 2\end{aligned}].
$$
worked_solution:
Notice that the matrix $[\begin{aligned}8 & 3 \\ 5 & 2\end{aligned}]$ appears on both sides of the equation. Since this matrix is invertible (its determinant is not zero), left-multiplying the equation by the inverse gives the following expression for $B:$ 

$$
B={{{[\begin{aligned}8 & 3 \\ 5 & 2\end{aligned}]}^{-1}}_{⏟}}_{P}{{[\begin{aligned}-2 & 0 \\ 0 & 7\end{aligned}]}_{⏟}}_{D}{{[\begin{aligned}8 & 3 \\ 5 & 2\end{aligned}]}_{⏟}}_{{P}^{-1}}
$$

Therefore, $B$ is diagonalizable. The eigenvalues of $B$ are ${\lambda }_{1}=-2$ and ${\lambda }_{2}=7$ and the corresponding eigenvectors are the columns of the matrix $P.$ Computing $P,$ we obtain

$$
\begin{aligned}P={[\begin{aligned}8 & 3 \\ 5 & 2\end{aligned}]}^{-1}=\frac{1}{1}[\begin{aligned}2 & -3 \\ -5 & 8\end{aligned}]=[\begin{aligned}2 & -3 \\ -5 & 8\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$

In conclusion, the corresponding eigenvectors are: 

$\,$ ${v}_{1}=[\begin{aligned}2 \\ -5\end{aligned}]\,$ and $\,{v}_{2}=[\begin{aligned}-3 \\ 8\end{aligned}]$

Question 5

Find the eigenvectors of the 2×2 matrix B given that [8352]B=[−2007][8352].

a
[2−6] and [−30]
b
[2−5] and [−38]
c
[1−3] and [04]
d
[2−3] and [−36]
e
[3−5] and [−28]
Submit
Correct
EXPLANATION

Notice that the matrix [8352] appears on both sides of the equation. Since this matrix is invertible (its determinant is not zero), left-multiplying the equation by the inverse gives the following expression for B: B=[8352]−1⏟P[−2007]⏟D[8352]⏟P−1

Therefore, B is diagonalizable. The eigenvalues of B are λ1=−2 and λ2=7 and the corresponding eigenvectors are the columns of the matrix P. Computing P, we obtain

P=[8352]−1=11[2−3−58]=[2−3−58].

In conclusion, the corresponding eigenvectors are:

v1=[2−5] and v2=[−38]
